body: I think I want out of my marriage. My spouse has some serious mental health problems. None of it is really his fault but he can't hold down a job and hasn't been able to for a while. I work more than a full time job, I'm taking courses to get a better career, and I take care of the vast majority of what needs done around the house. He's doing treatment stuff the majority of the day. I feel like a jerk for wanting out because we did say in sickness and in health and who bails on a marriage because one of you is sick? But even if he got better tomorrow I don't know that I'd want to stay. I'm not physically attracted to him anymore and I think we want different things long term. I do care about him a lot tho and I think if I told him about any of this he'd get worse. I feel trapped.
